The intense sweetness of pumpkins makes this dessert popular among children.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Pumpkin Pies by [[Cooking]] a [[Fortified Pumpkin]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Cane Sugar]], and [[Goat Butter]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The default version can only be made by adding either a [[Fruit]] or a [[Vegetable]] with an effect that differs from Fortified Pumpkins. When eaten, they will restore some of his [[Heart]]s. Due to the sweetness of Fortified Pumpkins, these desserts are popular among children. Only one variation of Pumpkin Pie exists: * '''Tough Pumpkin Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Pumpkin Pie}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The intense sweetness of fortified pumpkins makes this dessert popular among children.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding no additional ingredients. By consuming these Pies, Link's defense will be temporarily boosted. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Two variations of Pumpkin Pie exist: * '''Sunny Pumpkin Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sunny Pumpkin Pie}}
Restores hearts damaged by gloom.
The intense sweetness of pumpkins makes this dessert popular among children.|Inventory|TotK}} Made with [[Sun Pumpkin]]s. By consuming these Pies, any [[Heart]]s [[Link]] has lost to [[Gloom]] will be restored. * '''Tough Pumpkin Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Pumpkin Pie}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The intense sweetness of pumpkins makes this dessert popular among children.|Inventory|TotK}} Made with [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s.
